A security update for oauthlib and the Ubuntu packages in the image.

## 🎨 Design

- The README groups its download buttons under titles and draws the section headings as chapter bands.

## ⚡ Improved

- **oauthlib 4.0.1 in Seahub.** Seahub brings its own copy of oauthlib, and 4.0.0 has a high-severity advisory in the device code flow. Seahub uses oauthlib only for OAuth sign-in, which never takes that flow, but the image replaces the copy anyway. dnspython in the same folder is at 2.9.2, and pip at 26.3.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Ubuntu security updates reach the image again.** The build took the package upgrade from its cache, so newer fixes for apt, the BIND DNS tools and PCRE2 never made it into the image. The upgrade now runs fresh every week.
